summary: Comprehensive first-run test of VRCHINDO ERP. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases passed covering auth (login/me/logout/wrong-password/google-invalid/staff-403), users CRUD, shipping scan (SPX/AnterAja/SICEPAT/JNE/J&T/TIKTOK/TOKPED detection), duplicate handling, process->pengiriman flow with process-record update, cancel order PENGAJUAN/PEMBATALAN/MENARIK, RTS scan+patch, KPI, CSV export, gudang product CRUD + stok_riil formula + status (STOCK AMAN/RESTOCK/NEW STOCK), stock-adjustment mutation, marketplace stores/sync/orders/chats/promos CRUD, notifications, dashboard, POS checkout. Frontend: login flow works, dashboard renders, Scan Process Pesanan successfully scans a new SPX resi (status PROCESS PACKING), duplicate scan correctly shows JANGAN DIKIRIMKAN !! + DATA DOUBLE with toast alert, Gudang/Produk + Pengguna + POS + Marketplace pages all load without JS errors. data-testid selectors (scan-barcode-input, scan-process-button, package-row-<resi>, status-<resi>, warning-<resi>, header-calculator-button, header-theme-toggle, product-add-button) are present and functional.

issues: Login form inputs lack explicit data-testid (login-email-input / login-password-input). Only submit button has testid. Non-blocking but recommended for future automation.

critical_code_review_comments: routes_auth.set_jwt_cookies uses samesite='none'+secure=True which works for cross-site; verify behavior in local dev where secure=True cookies won't be set over http.
routes_shipping.auto_update is called on every GET /packages & /kpi; could cause write-amplification under load. Consider throttling (e.g., only run every N seconds).
routes_shipping.do_scan: cleanup/cascade for duplicate records is handled but there is no index on (submenu, no_resi) which may slow queries as data grows.
routes_gudang.to_int strips both ',' and '.' which can corrupt decimal values like '1.5' (becomes 15). Fine for integer stock fields but risky if reused for prices.
routes_marketplace.sync has random side-effects (new orders/chats). Pure-random demo is fine but makes tests non-deterministic.
routes_misc.checkout decreases stock via $inc stock_out but never checks race-condition / concurrent carts (acceptable for MVP).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). All green. detect() requires resi to START with the prefix (TEST_SPX... does NOT detect as SPX — only resis starting SPX/CM/JP/etc. work). Frontend data-testid conventions confirmed working for shipping scan flow. header-notifications-button testid did not resolve during probe — bell icon may use different testid; worth verifying if touching header.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing tests after fix. Initial self-written assertion in test_scan_process_spx used resi starting with 'TEST_SPX' which does not match SPX prefix rule in logic.detect; corrected test to use SPX-prefix resi, now passes.
